_readme: PARTIAL realm desired state for `dotmac`. Deliberately partial.
A FULL Keycloak realm export is NOT committed here and must never be: it
carries the realm's signing keys, client secrets and credential material.
The rule from the owner is absolute — no secret value in any file — and a
realm export is the easiest way to break it by accident.
The footprint of this file is deliberately identical to the footprint of
the policies in policy/: this repository declares exactly what it asserts,
and everything else about the realm is named in docs/HOST-IMPORT-TODO.md
as an unreconciled region rather than silently implied to be correct.
The issuer is PERMANENT. It is written into every
`external_identity_bindings.issuer` row in every relying party, so changing
it orphans every binding rather than renaming them.
